steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In July 2021, a guest on Equity Mates said Treasury Wine Estates needed to place its premium range, likened to Mercedes, into markets outside China, highlighting the strength of its brands despite channel disruption.

episode.title: Expert Investor: Andrew Brown - Bold Predictions

views.text: In January 2021, Equity Mates explained Treasury Wine Estates was a vertically integrated global wine business, covering grape growing, production, marketing, sales and distribution, which showed control over product and brand.

episode.title: Summer Series: Treasury Wine Estates Ltd (ASX: TWE)

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In July 2021, a guest on Equity Mates said about 30% of Treasury Wine Estates’ earnings from China would be missing for the foreseeable future, challenging profitability even as its brand value remained a key asset.

episode.title: Expert Investor: Andrew Brown - Bold Predictions

views.text: In September 2020, a guest on Equity Mates said Chinese investigations into Australian wine exports pushed Treasury Wine Estates down 14% for the month, showing how China exposure weighed on returns.

episode.title: Expert Investor: Market & Watchlist Update With Julia Lee

views.text: In August 2020, Equity Mates reported Treasury Wine Estates’ revenue fell 7% and profit fell 36%, and noted a Chinese anti dumping investigation that hit the share price and threatened profitability.

episode.title: EM Chat: ASX Reporting Season - Winners & Losers

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In July 2021, a guest on Equity Mates said Treasury Wine Estates planned to redirect its premium range into the US and other markets after losing China, outlining a pathway to keep the business growing.

episode.title: Expert Investor: Andrew Brown - Bold Predictions

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In July 2021, a guest on Equity Mates noted that if Treasury Wine Estates’ share price fell materially, its strong brands could become attractive, framing valuation in light of the China earnings shortfall.
